notes.title: Hotfix Update #1712283849
notes.content:
We have identified some bugs that affect the use of NotificationCat VR along with Windows version updates, and have fixed known bugs.

- When the Windows system experience version package is equal to or lower than version 1000.22688.1000.0, the Toast mode message capture function will be broken

- The Dashboard program will not automatically close when NotificationCat VR is closed, which will cause Steam to always have NotificationCat VR running.

- NotificationCat VR now also displays its connection status when you run Toast mode.

- Added status box to Toast mode so you can easily check what the problem is when the program doesn't work.

- Dashboard program now displays icons correctly in SteamVR


!!!This update involves the Toast mode program, please be sure to download and install the new Toast program manually!!!

notes.title: Happy New Year! Lunar New Year Update and Roadmap Arrived
notes.content:
Celebrating the Lunar New Year, amidst the sound of firecrackers, "NotificationCat VR" ushered in the fourth version update and the announcement of the software update roadmap!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44555811/07727f812f0f3b27f484637e2fb70228af00691b.png

PC

v1.3 -> v1.4

Fixed an issue where the prompt audio could not be played in some cases when the prompt notification sound effect function was turned on.

Fixed an issue where the Dashboard setup program would not render correctly when the software had multiple GPU devices (especially laptop devices)

Fixed an issue where the Toast helper would be launched repeatedly under certain circumstances

Toast

v1.1.0.0 -> v1.2.0.0

Fixed a bug where notifications would not be forwarded properly when the Toast helper encountered an update

Fixed an error that caused the Toast helper program to exit abnormally when an error occurred.

notes.title: Merry Christmas ! The Christmas update !
notes.content:
Merry Christmas!

The train to the end of the year is about to arrive, and the Vortex Studio team sends you their sincerest holiday greetings. At the same time, Santa Claus and the software developer Kevin Anderson also bring us the Christmas version update of "NotificationCat VR", letting you enjoy more fun and surprises in VR games on this beautiful holiday.

PC v1.2 -> v1.3

Introducing milestone features of software: SteamVR internal program settings interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44555811/071aeda0ae80abf1b85ea51e7daee3c28f66243b.png

You don't need to take off your headset, "NotificationCat VR" now provides an interface for setting up VR inside. You can adjust various settings of the software in real time in VR. At the same time, VR inside Dashboard means that software will provide more practical functions to enhance immersive experience for players in future updates!

History of notifications

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44555811/f6424ebaf8bcc7dec020099419c437f9f6773f3c.png

Did you miss a message or need to view a historical notification? You don't need to pick up your phone, you can view historical notification messages in VR inside Dashboard!

Do Not Disturb mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44555811/30146fc3dc8569a1e72f1280145c6b0c749b3d25.png

When mobile devices during game process encounter message barrage or temporarily don't want to be disturbed? You don't need to close reopen software, just start or close disturb function switch in dashboard can solve this kind of problem!

Notification sound

Now, software will play sound effects after transferring notifications into VR. This feature is default on, you can close this feature in settings panel.

Last

"NotificationCat VR" thanks you for your support and trust, and also looks forward to your feedback and suggestions on our Christmas version update. Merry Christmas, and happy new year!

notes.title: Preliminary improvement - version update
notes.content:
Preliminary improvement

Everyone, This is the first version update since the software was released! We are gradually adding new features to the software while ensuring its stability and applicability. These new features will continuously improve the software to get through this stage and enhance the player experience.

PC Version
v1.1 --> v1.2

- Added feature to display real-time connection status with Android

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44555811/0383029fa43884bb608e8ae6ea9e925ce3cd4245.png

Now, you can view the connection status between your PC and Android devices in real-time in PC applications. When an Android device unexpectedly disconnects, you can promptly view and reconnect your Android device.

- Fixed issue of mismatch between localized language and help document links

- Readjust the program layout to make it look more refreshing

- Fixed issue of mismatch between localized language and download channel

- Fixed issue where startup programs crash when Windows has no network connection

Android 
v1 --> v2

-Added the function of displaying real-time connection status with PC

-Removed customized Android system permission warning

-Fixed some errors where text was not localized in English

-Fixed an error where the program received messages from certain applications and forwarded them to VR twice

 UWP 

- Redesign layout
